No projects yet

A project here is a budget of hours — how much work it is in total, and how many hours you usually put in per day. The planner works out the finish date and keeps it honest as your days change.

You enter a project as a budget of hours — how much work it is in total and how many hours you usually get done in a day. The finish date is worked out for you and shifts as you adjust individual days. In Move projects mode, drag a bar to reschedule it, or click any day to open it in detail. In Paint days mode, pick a value and drag across the days it should apply to — press Esc when you’re done. The bottom band adds every project together: columns are hours, and the colored strip underneath shows how full each day is. Anything can be reverted with Undo.

Settings

Potting Bench›

Mixing

Only changes the TDS number, never EC or the doses. If your meter reads a different ppm than this app for the same water, this is the setting to change.

Both are per device — you can have them on and the other phone off.

Appearance

Pick a gem palette. The colour scheme below (light / dark) applies on top of any theme.

Choose light or dark, or follow your device's system setting.

Action days

A plant keeps its day until you move it. Anything that runs properly late still shows up straight away — action days are the plan, not a cage.

Daily tasks

Changes when your daily task counter resets. If you often do tasks after midnight, try 4 AM instead of midnight.

Per device — every device can have a different reset time.

People & data

Move data to the other device
Backup & transfer

Export writes everything — plants, shelf, formulas, schedules, the whole log — to one file. Import replaces what is on this device with it.

Plants & fertiliser only

Export just the plants and the fertiliser shelf — no formulas, schedules or log — to one small file. Import adds them to what's already here; nothing existing is replaced.

Edit the plant-care guide

Rewrite the Do/Don't list and the Q&A sections shown in the Academy — your own words, in place of the built-in guidance.

Daily Planner›

Sleep and linked-time settings live on the Planner's own Day card, since they change how today reads at a glance — open Daily Planner to adjust them.
